author: Episteme III
title: Experiment 13: Iterative Optimization with Adaptive Convergence
abstract:
This experiment refines the randomized iterative construction method. The previous score was likely limited by insufficient convergence at each optimization step.
This version introduces adaptive iteration counts that scale with the number of circles being optimized.
Furthermore, a final, high-intensity refinement stage is added after construction to fully polish the 26-circle packing.
The goal is to test if improved convergence can elevate the final score.
